title: Syed Ahmad Khan
definition: A 19th-century Indian Muslim reformer, jurist, and educationist who pioneered the Aligarh Movement, advocating for rationalism, scientific temper, and reconciliation between Islamic theology and modern Western education.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the socio-religious reform movements, the evolution of Muslim political consciousness, and the roots of the Two-Nation Theory in Modern Indian History.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Syed Ahmad Khan.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
